text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is always a massive 
spectacle every year. Every Umamusume who 
runs is chosen by fan vote, meaning each 
runner is among that year's very best.

However, things looked slightly different 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Against Senior Class opponents, I wonder 
how far Symboli Rudolf can go... I can't 
wait to see!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I honestly wonder about that. There's 
a girl on the verge of retirement, and I 
still think she's gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, knowing the "Emperor," she's sure 
to place in the top three. Which is why—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Back already, Trainer-kun? How did things 
look outside?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so. I'm grateful for that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People seem to have high expectations... 
to see how well I can hold my own against 
the seniors and my capable peers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, I cannot yet claim to 
have won the people's hearts."

In this fan vote, Symboli Rudolf ceded 
first place to her senior and took second. 
Apparently, it's been weighing on her 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Votes don't directly equate to trust. 
However, they do symbolize where I 
currently stand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are those who claim that even I 
stand no chance against those with so much 
experience under their belt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In other words, there are still those who 
doubt my abilities. If so, there is only 
one thing to do.
